title: Cash-Only Restaurants in Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin is not simply cash-only or card-only.** Cashless payments are widespread, but an individual food business can set its own acceptance rules.
**Ask before you order.** At a bakery, market stall or sit-down restaurant, "Kann ich mit Karte zahlen?" is enough to make the decision early.
**Carry a modest backup, not a magic amount.** Keep only an amount of cash that feels sensible for a small unexpected food payment and your own comfort.
**Do not let one venue create a rescue mission.** If card payment is not accepted, decide before the order is final whether cash, an ATM or another place is the practical move.
Use the Berlin Meal Wallet to rehearse one short payment exchange for the food moment you are about to have.
